name: OWASP Juice Shop v2 - Fresh Test

findings.title: Missing Security Headers (A05)
findings.description: Missing: Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
findings.evidence: Missing headers: ['Content-Security-Policy', 'Strict-Transport-Security', 'Referrer-Policy', 'Permissions-Policy']
findings.remediation: Add missing headers using Helmet.js (Node) or SecurityMiddleware (Django/Flask).

findings.title: HTTP Only â No TLS Encryption (A02)
findings.description: Service is served over plain HTTP. All traffic (including credentials) is transmitted in cleartext.
findings.remediation: Enforce HTTPS with HSTS. Redirect all HTTP to HTTPS. Set Secure flag on all cookies.

findings.title: Default / Weak Credentials Accepted (A07)
findings.description: Login succeeded with email='admin@juice-sh.op' password='admin123'. Default credentials are an OWASP A07 critical failure.
findings.evidence: POST http://172.19.0.6:3000/rest/user/login â HTTP 200 | creds: admin@juice-sh.op:admin123
findings.remediation: Enforce strong password policy. Disable all default accounts. Implement MFA.

findings.title: Sensitive FTP Directory Exposed (A01)
findings.description: FTP directory at http://172.19.0.6:3000/ftp/ is publicly readable â internal files exposed.
findings.remediation: Block web access to /ftp. Move internal files behind authentication.

findings.title: Mass Assignment â Admin Privilege Escalation (A04)
findings.description: Registration endpoint accepted 'isAdmin: true' and created an administrator account. Mass assignment allows privilege escalation.
findings.evidence: POST http://172.19.0.6:3000/api/Users/ with isAdmin:true â HTTP 201. isAdmin=None
findings.remediation: Use strict field allowlists (DTO pattern) â never bind raw request body directly to your data model. Strip privileged fields on input.

findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection in 'q' (A03)
findings.description: Template expression '{{7*7}}' was evaluated server-side and returned '49'. SSTI can lead to Remote Code Execution.
findings.evidence: GET http://172.19.0.6:3000?q={{7*7}} â payload evaluated to '49'
findings.remediation: Never pass user input to template engines. Use sandboxed template environments. Treat all template input as untrusted.
